cv.name: Jordan Montgomery
cv.headline: Chemistry Teacher (Grades 9–12) | Former QC chemist
cv.summary: Certified chemistry teacher who moved into education after two years as a quality control chemist. I bring lab experience into the classroom and have taught chemistry and IPC for five years in Central Texas public schools.

experience.title: Chemistry Teacher
bullets: Teach Chemistry and Pre-AP Chemistry to about 150 students in grades 10–11
Redesigned lab safety training and lab write-ups using real QC procedures
Raised the share of students meeting grade level on the district chemistry benchmark from 61% to 74%
Sponsor of the school's Science Olympiad team

experience.title: Science Teacher (IPC)
bullets: First-year teacher of Integrated Physics and Chemistry at a charter school

experience.title: Quality Control Chemist
bullets: HPLC and wet chemistry testing of raw materials under GMP
Wrote and reviewed SOPs and trained new lab technicians
